weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg1:start to seg1:end show five horizontal tracks (1983 to 2023) that never fill. The values -8 to -2.3 are just text in a right-hand column, and Data floats between rows. It repeats seg0's temperature data with less motion.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The bar renderer drew negative temperatures as zero-length bars on a 0-based axis, so no mark carries the warming. The mascot has no anchor on any moving part.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Replace seg1 with one bespoke picture of the ground warming: a cross-section of frozen soil with a thermometer column that Data pushes from -8 up to -2.3 as the ice layer visibly shrinks and turns to mud. It must not repeat seg0's data, and the 0°C line should be drawn so 'just 2 below' reads at a glance.
